sources.title: Strix · GitHub
sources.snippet: Strix is an open-source, agentic security platform that helps teams identify exploitable vulnerabilities and security misconfigurations across modern apps. Strix runs AI agents that plan, investigate, and validate issues end-to-end, producing actionable findings you can remediate quickly.
